text_block_list.text:
In a rare display, I find Эйр Грув fixed
on her
phone in spite of the approaching
start of the
race.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Dober just messaged me. She's coming
to watch.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
If she's watching, then I have no choice
but to
deliver my challenge.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
I can sense that Эйр Грув is ready to
go! I just
need to send her off and trust
her to give this
race her all.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
